Summaries keep the source wording. did_you_know facts are either Wikipedia "Did you know" hooks (text only, reformatted) or one-sentence rewordings of existing entries (prefixed with the date, possibly shortened). did_you_know.fact: On February 6, 1959: Jack Kilby of Texas Instruments files the first patent for an integrated circuit.
On February 6, 1959: At Cape Canaveral, Florida, the first successful test firing of a Titan intercontinental ballistic missile is accomplished.
On February 6, 1851: The largest Australian bushfires in a populous region in recorded history take place in the state of Victoria.
February 6 is observed as Sami National Day (Russia, Finland, Norway and Sweden).
